claim: Patchline ships a ten-million-migration mining run with a public, queryable, content-addressed index. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the content-addressed claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make ten-million-migration-mining-gate`.
